runtime.defaultPrivilege: non-root; no daemon socket, elevation or automatic authentication
runtime.aciException: Explicit STUDIO_ALLOW_ACI_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP=true and target aci only: stage configured runtime files, then remove supplementary groups and drop GID/UID to 1000 before starting a fresh Node process.
runtime.secretProjection: Root-owned broadly readable secrets are accepted only beneath /run/studio when an actual read-only Linux mount is observed. Otherwise require restricted file read permissions. Public credential-free runtime configuration may be 0644.

hostedConnector.transport: SDK 1.0.34 supports plaintext raw TCP URI connections, not HTTPS. Only an explicit authenticated loopback endpoint to an owner-managed TLS tunnel is accepted; remote plaintext and unsupported HTTPS fail closed.
hostedConnector.identity: The external runtime owns Copilot authentication. Cloud workload identity does not automatically authenticate GitHub Copilot.

reviewedOperations.storage: Protected JSON and adapter scripts/artifact outside the product; no embedded credentials.
reviewedOperations.commandShape: {command,args,script?,env:[],timeoutMs?,maximumOutputBytes?}; installed CLI or explicitly reviewed Node/Python/PowerShell script; no shell, inline code or credential arguments.
reviewedOperations.stdin: {version:1,action,phase,policyDigest,input}; plan receives head/cycleId, validate/apply receive the exact immutable plan.
reviewedOperations.planOutput: {head,maximumCost,currency,costSource,target,artifactDigest,details?}; the adapter computes a digest bound to policy, code and actual artifact bytes.
reviewedOperations.applyOutput: {success:true,planDigest,receipt?}; an uncertain apply cannot be replayed.
reviewedOperations.buildPrograms: Named commands are supplied to FactoryController for isolated execution, never run as credentialed controller scripts.

workerBounds.recovery: No transport/auth/lease retries. Deployment restart policy is an independently reviewed operator setting, not worker-issued continuation authority.

maven.source: Ubuntu 24.04 maven package; actual version captured in /opt/adhd/provenance/apt-packages.txt

checksumVerification.note: The versioned and published archives have identical tar payloads but different gzip bytes. Pin the SHA256 of the exact versioned archive, not the unversioned download-page checksum.

securityPatch.verification: Go checksum database, kubectl version-command unit tests, go mod verify and the unchanged critical Grype gate

provenance.nodeDependencies: npm ci --ignore-scripts from package-lock.json, including the Linux x64 SDK runtime
provenance.distributionDependencies: Ubuntu security updates and Python CLI transitive dependencies are captured in build inventories, not claimed byte-reproducible.
provenance.promotion: Review the completed image and use its registry@sha256 digest; never promote by mutable tag alone.
provenance.liveAssurance: Docker builds, vulnerability/license scans, cloud placement, Linux flock and ACI mounts require separately authorized execution.
